title: CoMem: Collective-Individual Memory Synergy for Evolutionary Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.15009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing effective memory mechanisms is crucial for advancing LLM-driven Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), helping agents learn together and perform better over time. While recent work has led to strong cooperation skills, most methods still use flat, unstructured memories, which easily get filled with noise and erase differences between agents. To address this, we introduce the concept of collective-individual memory synergy and propose CoMem, an architecture that unifies both private experience and shared knowledge for multi-agent learning. CoMem features:(i) Private Experience Sedimentation, which lets each agent keep and update its own useful memories over time;(ii) Collective Wisdom Curation, which carefully selects only widely proven ideas to be shared among agents;(iii)Parallel Dual-Stream Retrieval, which allows agents to draw both from their own memory and the group's wisdom, using clustering to ensure diversity.Experiments on ALFWorl

translated_title: CoMem：面向演化多智能体系统的集体-个体记忆协同机制
translated_abstract: 设计有效的记忆机制对于推进基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）至关重要，能够帮助智能体共同学习并随时间推移不断提升表现。尽管近期研究已使智能体具备了较强的协作能力，但大多数方法仍采用扁平化、非结构化的记忆，这容易导致记忆中充斥噪声，并抹杀智能体之间的个体差异。为解决这一问题，我们提出了集体-个体记忆协同的概念，并提出CoMem——一种统一私有经验与共享知识的多智能体学习架构。CoMem包含三大特性：(i) 私有经验沉淀，使每个智能体能够随时间保留并更新自身有用的记忆；(ii) 集体智慧策展，精心筛选仅经过广泛验证的想法供智能体之间共享；(iii) 并行双流检索，使智能体能够同时从自身记忆和群体智慧中获取信息，并利用聚类确保多样性。在ALFWorld上的实验……
tldr: 提出CoMem架构，通过私有经验沉淀、集体智慧策展和并行双流检索三大机制，统一个体记忆与群体智慧，解决了多智能体系统中记忆噪声化和同质化的问题。
en_tdlr: CoMem is a memory architecture for LLM-driven multi-agent systems that unifies private experience sedimentation and collective wisdom curation with parallel dual-stream retrieval, overcoming the noise and homogenization issues of flat, unstructured memories.
